listing.name: It Came From Beyond 0.1.3
listing.summary: Adds a new faction called the Boundless, ships to go along with them, and campaign-level features such as a new storyline and ability.

description:
Adds a new faction called *the Boundless*, ships to go along with them, and campaign-level features such as a new storyline and ability.

The faction inhabits two new star systems to the Southeast of the core worlds. Enjoy exploring the new worlds! This mod is still early in development, so it's a little thin on features as-of-yet, but I plan to add much and more. More new ships, weapons, and expansions to the storyline. If you need a hint as to how to start the story: ||head to the system called Kato||. ***Requires MagicLib and LazyLib.***

Download: https://github.com/JohnShmo/Project_ItCameFromBeyond/releases/latest/download/ItCameFromBeyond.zip
Forum Thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=30923.0
